title: AC blowing warm: outdoor fan not starting

sources.text: Job ticket: customer reports the AC is blowing warm air since this morning. Indoor fan runs. Single-story house, one system, condenser on the side yard. Not a maintenance plan member.

Condenser contactor is pulled in, compressor is humming but the outdoor fan isn't spinning. Gave the fan a push with a stick and it took off. Run capacitor is bulged on top. Swapped the cap from the truck, fan and compressor both start on their own now.
Pressures were a little low after it ran fifteen minutes, so I topped it off with 410A. Supply air is 56 degrees now, return is 75, so we've got a 19 degree split.
CAP-35/5 Dual run capacitor 35/5 MFD, installed: $185. CAP-45/5 Dual run capacitor 45/5 MFD, installed: $205. R410-LB Refrigerant R-410A, per pound: $95. LEAK-01 Electronic leak search: $249.

If it was low on charge there's a leak somewhere. I'd recommend the leak search before next summer instead of just adding refrigerant every year. Customer wants to think about it, send them the price.
Thanks, house is cooling down already. Please email me the leak search price.

expect.recommendation: Electronic leak search before next summer
